component.name: Aria
component.summary: Free, unlimited, local AI music creation

description.p: Aria generates complete songs with sung vocals entirely on your own computer. No account, no credits, no subscription. Everything you make is yours.
The music model weights are downloaded the first time you run the app (several gigabytes). They are not included in this package. After that, Aria works offline. There is no telemetry.
First packaged Linux build: AppImage, .deb, and a local Flatpak wrap.
